banner.title: Impersonating {{target}}
banner.body: You are viewing TeslaSync as another subject. End impersonation to restore your session.

confirm.title: Start impersonation session?
confirm.message: You will see TeslaSync as {{subject}} for up to 15 minutes. The action is logged to the audit log. End the session from the banner when you are done.

users.title: Subjects
users.subtitle: Active subjects you can impersonate for support. Sessions are limited to 15 minutes and recorded in the audit log.
users.openMode: Impersonation requires forward-auth mode. This install is in open mode, so per-user identity is not available.
users.emptyMessage: No other subjects have an active session right now. Sign someone else in to enable impersonation.

brief.scope: Current impersonation status and available session subjects are independent sources. Open mode disables subject discovery.
brief.limit: Configured policy limit of 15 minutes, not the active session’s remaining time.
brief.title: Subject and session posture

status.title: Session status
status.error: Session status is unavailable right now. Use the refresh control above to try again.
status.open: Forward-auth is disabled, so impersonation is unavailable on this install.
status.activeCallout: Impersonation is active. End it from the banner at the top of the screen.
status.inactive: You are not impersonating anyone. Pick a subject from the table to start a support session.

audit.title: Every session is audit-logged
audit.body: Starting and ending a session writes an immutable entry to the admin audit log with the actor and the target.

ttl.title: 15-minute time limit
ttl.body: A session expires automatically after 15 minutes so a forgotten session cannot linger.

sudo.title: Step-up auth to start
sudo.body: Starting a session requires a fresh re-authentication prompt; ending one never does.

forwardAuth.title: Forward-auth required
forwardAuth.body: Per-subject identity only exists when the proxy runs in forward-auth mode. Open-mode installs cannot impersonate.

exit.title: End it any time
exit.body: The global banner at the top of the screen ends the active session immediately and restores your own view.

policy.title: How impersonation works
policy.intro: Impersonation lets an admin view TeslaSync exactly as another subject to reproduce a support issue. It is deliberately constrained:
